name: Decrease
theme: Decrease removes excess so sincerity can be felt. Less is not deprivation when it returns attention to what matters.
basicInterpretation: Offer something unnecessary back to the world. A smaller gesture made with truth can carry more life than an impressive display.
reflectionPrompt: What could you release to become more sincere?

reversed.theme: Turned around, Decrease becomes Hexagram 42, Increase. This other side brings in the atmosphere of growth, generosity, blessing, asking how the situation may look from another threshold.
reversed.reflection: Let Increase widen the reading rather than replace it. Consider what another person, timing, or hidden part of you might see when the pattern is viewed from the far side.

opposite.theme: The contrast to Decrease is Hexagram 31, Influence. Where the primary pattern emphasizes simplification, sacrifice, sincerity, this complementary field points toward attraction, response, sensitivity.
opposite.reflection: This is not the main movement of the reading, but it shows what balances or challenges it. Notice where Influence names the medicine, shadow, or unchosen path beside the situation.
